label: Bottom
description: Named trousers, jeans, shorts, skirts, leggings and bib overalls, distinguished by cut and construction.
notes: Single lower-body garments belong here, along with bib overalls that leave the upper body open for a separate top. clothing.top owns shirts and other tops, while clothing.dress owns full jumpsuits, rompers and catsuits. Values follow wearing as singular garment names or natural plural trouser names, with no chosen color or complete outfit. Shared cuts remain available to any presentation, while clearly gendered skirts and lingerie bottoms carry presentation tags; lingerie and fetish garments are adult-only.
